items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: Except see Garfunkel has a great group with him, and he features everybody.

ctx.x: Oh God. It’s so lifeless. Except see Garfunkel has a great group with him, and he features everybody. And the only time the stage gets any energy is when the guys play. Everything else is like [scats]. Very mournful. This is only one man’s opinion. Why should I, I shouldn’t, erase that.
No. Well you know your opinion, plus I’ve never seen Garfunkel live. I think of him with Simon.
